title: PainSignal
description: A single independently sourced real-world pain signal extracted from public material (issue #9 Part 1). One signal = one source item. Copies/reposts are marked duplicate_of rather than counted as independent evidence.

signal_id.description: Stable id: sha1(source_type + source_id + normalized pain statement)[:16]

source_type.description: Source class key from sources.json (e.g. hn_algolia, stack_exchange, github_issues, reddit_public_json)

published_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC publication date if known

source_author.description: Public username/handle; used only for independence counting

target_role.description: Inferred target role/user, or null if not inferable

pain_statement.description: Best sentence(s) stating the problem, lightly cleaned, <= 400 chars

current_workaround.description: How the source says they cope today

named_systems.description: Canonical names of software/systems mentioned (e.g. Excel, Xero, Shopify)

confidence.description: Extraction confidence from cue density; NOT a market score

raw_excerpt.description: Short excerpt (<= max_raw_excerpt_chars) kept for audit; not the full copyrighted text

duplicate_of.description: Canonical signal_id if this was classified as a duplicate/repost
